narrative.overview: The catalogue leads with the action and keeps reasoning visible. White and near-white surfaces, asymmetric whitespace, editorial rules, a near-black primary, and direct text links create orientation without spectacle.

rules.name: Functional Color
rules.body: Color is functional, not atmospheric decoration.

rules.name: Field Manual Type
rules.body: Use Outfit with the Noto Sans/system sans fallback for prose and headings.

rules.name: Flat With Hairline Rules
rules.body: The system is flat. Do not use shadows, gradients, floating cards, glass, or decorative depth.

rules.name: Components Present
rules.body: Document only the components present in the catalogue.

dos: Do lead with the official Trade search or practical craft step, then show concise reasoning and cheaper alternatives where they exist.
Do keep links, export actions, and context visible on the page; use descriptive labels and semantic landmarks.
Do use clean technical mono cues: monospace for numbers, regex, and metadata; Outfit/Noto Sans for prose and headings.
Do use white/near-white surfaces, hairline rules, asymmetrical whitespace, direct text actions, and the near-black primary.
Do preserve strong contrast, keyboard focus, readable zoom behavior, and the existing 700px/560px responsive changes.
Do respect `prefers-reduced-motion`; motion must never reveal instructions or copy a Trade query.
donts: Don’t make build-guide pages that bury Trade links beneath ads, video embeds, or broad aspirational advice.
Don’t use slick SaaS patterns, marketing CTAs, or decorative dashboard metrics.
Don’t use loot-splash spectacle, artificial urgency, or exaggerated rarity effects.
Don’t make opaque recommendations that name an item without the actual search, context, or a cheaper alternative.
Don’t invent inputs, cards, chips, pills, dashboards, shadows, gradients, or promotional hero treatments for this catalogue.
Don’t replace direct text actions with filled controls or obscure the operational result behind animation.
